_comment: AUTHORED approve + land expectations. Script: steward maria accepts the #Recent description; admin confirms one send to a catalog.

derived_after_approve.ownership(#Recent description): human — via accepting disposition, though every version is machine-authored (the certification-without-edit branch of the ownership lens)
derived_after_approve.pipeline_behavior: future produce versions for this target render as PROPOSED, never current
derived_after_approve.refusal_case: a disposition authored by an agent identity -> REFUSED (LC3-C3)

land_script.expect: native columns only; ZERO custom attributes; machine text definitions open with the attribution prefix

land_script.expect_order: proposal SENT event lands BEFORE transport (LAND-3)

derived_after_land.anti_repeat: a re-send of the SAME artifact version -> refused by LAND-2 unless a new version exists
derived_after_land.refusal_case: send without accepting disposition OR without human confirmation -> refused (LAND-1/B4)

_OPEN: F5-A: the rendered export's exact column sets per target system are build-slice bindings (the term-propose native sets are the ratified precedent); expectations here assert the RULES (zero custom attrs, prefix), not final headers.
